operating_notes.text: Headcount was 13,331 at 31 March 2026 (1,981 clinically trained), up 5.3% from 12,661 a year earlier, and net headcount declined from Q3FY26 to Q4FY26.
Client count is a little over 600, down from 700+ a year earlier after cutting the AQuity tail; management expects to settle between 500 and 600.
Top 10 customers contributed ₹452 Cr of Q4 revenue of ₹857 Cr and grew 28% in FY26; top 5 grew 18%.
Legacy IKS run-rate is about $97 million a quarter ($388 million annualised) and TruBridge about $75 million a quarter ($300 million annualised), for a combined $688 million revenue business.
Top 10 customer vintage is about six years and top five about seven years, with top-10 and top-5 revenue contribution flat versus Q4.
Adjusted FCF yield was 90% in the quarter after adjusting for a one-time NEVA customer payment; return on equity was 26%.

timeline.summary: On its Q4FY26 call (14 May 2026), IKS reported FY26 revenue of ₹3,193 Cr (up ~20%), PAT of ₹721 Cr (up 48%) and debt cut to ₹251 Cr, and set a True North target of about ₹3,000 Cr EBITDA in FY30.

watchlist.response: Sachin Gupta said 12% growth came on 4.2% headcount growth and is driven by operating efficiencies, not currency; aspiration is north of 12% constant currency but explicitly not guidance.
watchlist.text: Satyam Kumar asked what constant-currency growth is sustainable organically, noting 12% this quarter was among the slowest since listing and asking whether margin gains came from currency.

watchlist.response: Management said it cannot give a TruBridge revenue growth outlook yet and needs two to three quarters; only the legacy IKS 12%-plus aspiration was repeated.
watchlist.text: Aditi asked for a consolidated pro-forma revenue outlook after TruBridge consolidation and revenue synergies.

watchlist.response: Sachin Gupta said yes, because EBITDA is unchanged despite lower revenue, and it may be slightly more EPS accretive than imagined.
watchlist.text: Mayank Babla asked whether FY27 remains EPS accretive given the TruBridge revenue rationalisation not foreseen before the acquisition.

watchlist.response: Management cited technology deployment and offshore human-in-the-loop to reach early-to-mid 30s blended margin, and said the ₹3,000 Cr target does not require acquisitions but doors remain open.
watchlist.text: Madhuchanda Dey asked what the low-hanging levers are to lift TruBridge's 22-23% EBITDA margin and whether the no-dilution FY30 target rules out large acquisitions.
